title: Sunset Moonland
summary: A post-Cessation settlement beside deep blue water, shaped by exile, arrival and the possibility of belonging.

blocks.title: Sunset Moonland
blocks.subtitle: A place that can become home before you realize you stopped leaving.

blocks.heading: The place
paragraphs: Sunset Moonland is not important because it has escaped hardship. Its importance comes from a social fabric where the personal still reaches the system.
Its history accumulates across eras: exile, rediscovery, settlement, and finally the arrival of people who were only trying to pass through.

items.label: ≈ 500 years earlier
items.title: An exile finds the land
items.summary: A Luminary child in permanent exile withdraws here and slowly changes.

items.label: Before the Cessation
items.title: A fisherman returns
items.summary: A storm reveals the place; he later comes back with his wife.
